description: This file defines the GatewayConnection actor and related API for managing a WebSocket connection to a gateway service within the OpenClaw project. It includes enums, structs, and methods for communicating with the gateway, handling messages, health checks, session management, chat, voice wakeup, node and device pairing, and cron jobs. The file also manages configuration, subscriptions, and incorporates logging and error handling.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: An actor managing a persistent WebSocket connection to the gateway service, providing request/response methods, subscription management, configuration, and various API calls related to the gateway's functionalities.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Low-level method to send a request to the gateway via WebSocket, with retries and fallback logic for local and remote modes.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Performs a raw request to the gateway, returning the raw Data response.

methods.name: requestDecoded
methods.description: Performs a request and decodes the response into a Decodable type.

methods.name: requestVoid
methods.description: Performs a request that does not expect a response payload.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates an async stream of GatewayPush updates, allowing subscribers to receive snapshot updates and push notifications.

methods.name: healthSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches the health snapshot from the gateway.

methods.name: healthOK
methods.description: Checks if the gateway health status is OK.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Fetches the status report of installed skills.

methods.name: skillsInstall
methods.description: Installs a skill by name with the specified installId.

methods.name: skillsUpdate
methods.description: Updates a skill with given parameters.

methods.name: sessionsPreview
methods.description: Previews sessions by session keys.

methods.name: chatHistory
methods.description: Retrieves chat history for a given session.

methods.name: chatSend
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments.

methods.name: chatAbort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing chat run.

methods.name: talkMode
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode.

methods.name: voiceWakeGetTriggers
methods.description: Retrieves voice wake triggers.

methods.name: voiceWakeSetTriggers
methods.description: Sets voice wake triggers.

methods.name: nodePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a node pairing request.

methods.name: nodePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a node pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a device pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a device pairing request.

methods.name: cronStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of the cron scheduler.

methods.name: cronList
methods.description: Lists cron jobs.

methods.name: cronRuns
methods.description: Retrieves logs of cron job runs.

methods.name: cronRun
methods.description: Forces execution of a cron job.

methods.name: cronRemove
methods.description: Removes a cron job.

methods.name: cronUpdate
methods.description: Updates a cron job.

methods.name: cronAdd
methods.description: Adds a new cron job.
